objs.name: document
objs.description: A record that contains content and metadata managed through the policies and guidelines management system, subject to creation, editing, release, distribution and archiving workflows.

objs.name: policy
objs.description: A document type containing company-wide regulations and processes at a strategic level.

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: A document type that documents regulations and instructions at a locally or business-process level.

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: A document type that describes specific procedures within a framework and process sequences with responsible persons.

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: A document type that documents detailed work steps, test instructions and compliance criteria for sub-processes.

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: A supplementary document object type not subject to the release cycle of the main document, released directly via switches.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document object type automatically released with the main document and subject to own versioning.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A request to amend an existing document without affecting the document's content or version history.

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: A system-generated request to check and extend the validity of a document after a defined period.

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: A request to invalidate and archive a document that has no additional validity.

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: A request to re-validate and restore a previously invalidated document.

objs.name: user
objs.description: A person with defined roles and authorization groups in the system.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A collection of users assigned with specific authorization rights to documents.

objs.name: author
objs.description: A user role responsible for creating and editing document content.

objs.name: co_author
objs.description: A user with personal change rights on a document alongside the primary author.

objs.name: reviewer
objs.description: A user role responsible for checking document content according to technical and formal aspects.

objs.name: releaser
objs.description: A user role responsible for approving and releasing a document to readers.

objs.name: reader
objs.description: A user role with permission to view approved documents.

objs.name: translator
objs.description: A user role responsible for translating released document content into other languages.

objs.name: archive_group
objs.description: A user group with read access to archived documents.

objs.name: business_admin_group
objs.description: A user group permitted to create reactivation requests.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A collection of user groups and persons assigned to receive a document by email or acknowledgement.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: A process flow for document creation, review, release, and other lifecycle management activities.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: A predefined structure that can be selected when creating new documents of a specific type.

objs.name: document_version
objs.description: An instance of a document with a specific status and timestamp in its lifecycle.

objs.name: process
objs.description: A business or organizational process referenced or linked to documents.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: A company division or department that documents may be relevant to.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: A risk item that may be referenced or linked to documents.

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: A software application that may be referenced in document properties.

objs.name: company
objs.description: A business entity that may be specified in document validity scope.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Reference information in the system such as processes, organizational units, risks and IT applications.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: A confirmation by a user that they have received and reviewed a document.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A digital signature applied by workflow participants to document versions.

objs.name: audit_trail
objs.description: A record of all changes, approvals and actions performed on a document.

objs.name: pdf
objs.description: A document format to which released documents are automatically converted.

objs.name: language_version
objs.description: A translated version of a document in a specific language.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Initiate a new document by attaching a new information object and selecting a document type.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Modify the content of a document using the editing client and Office components.

evts.name: maintain_document_properties
evts.description: Update the metadata and attributes of a document such as references, scope, and IT applications.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Approve and publish a document through the workflow-supported three-step release process with signature.

evts.name: sign_document
evts.description: Apply an electronic signature to a document version by a workflow participant.

evts.name: distribute_document_by_email
evts.description: Send email notifications to assigned user groups and persons when a new document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Request users to actively confirm receipt and review of a released document version.

evts.name: acknowledge_document
evts.description: Confirm receipt and review of a document by a user on the distribution list.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Submit a proposal to amend an existing document without affecting version history.

evts.name: implement_change_proposal
evts.description: Create a new document version based on an approved change proposal.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: System-generated request when a document reaches 30 days before validity expiration.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Approve and extend the validity period of a document after checking its continued applicability.

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Create a new editing version of a released document with retained data from previous version.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: Initiate a request to invalidate a document that has no additional validity.

evts.name: declare_override
evts.description: Invalidate a document and revoke all user authorizations except for the archive group.

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: Withdraw a document from active use and restrict access except for archival group during archive period.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: Submit a request to re-validate a previously invalidated document.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Restore an archived document to active status with original metadata and properties.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translate released document content into another language.

evts.name: review_translation
evts.description: Check and evaluate a translated document version for accuracy and completeness.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Approve and publish a translated document version through workflow-supported process.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Grant specific read or change permissions to users or user groups for a document.

evts.name: upload_external_file
evts.description: Attach an external file or document to a document object in the system.

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically convert a document to PDF format after content is saved.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Mark an attachment as archived when no longer relevant to a new document version.

evts.name: delete_attachment
evts.description: Remove an attachment from the system after it has been marked for archiving.

o2o.description: A document may reference or be linked to another document.
A document may have one or more attachments.
A document may have one or more additional information objects.
A change proposal belongs to and is displayed in a specific document.
A validity extension request is linked to the document to be checked.
An override request is linked to the document being invalidated.
A document may be automatically linked to processes.
A document may be linked to organizational units and stored process-specifically.
A document may be linked to risks.
A document may reference IT applications in its properties.
A document may specify relevant companies in its scope of validity.
A document may have translated versions in different languages.
A document is created based on a selected document template of its type.
A document has a distribution list specifying user groups and persons for access.
A policy may document organizational processes and structure.
A guideline may describe regulations relating to a business process.
A procedural instruction describes the sequence and details of a process.
Attachments are subject to their own versioning parallel to the main document.
A user may be assigned to one or more user groups.
An author creates and has change rights on documents.
A co-author has personal change rights alongside the primary author.
A reviewer checks documents during the review workflow step.
A releaser approves documents in the release workflow step.
A reader has permission to view approved documents.
A translator creates and translates language versions of documents.
An invalidated document with override status may later be subject to a reactivation request.
Each released document version has associated electronic signatures from workflow participants.

o2e.description: A document is the object created in this event.
A user performs the action of creating a document.
A document is edited to modify its content.
An author edits the document content.
A document has its metadata and properties updated.
A user maintains the document's properties.
A document is released through the workflow process.
An author initiates the release process.
A reviewer approves the document during review.
A releaser approves the document during release.
A document version is signed.
An author signs in the creation workflow step.
A reviewer signs after completing the review.
A releaser signs after completing the release.
A translator may sign a translated version.
A document is distributed to user groups and persons via email.
A user group receives email notification of document release.
A document triggers acknowledgement requests to users.
A user confirms acknowledgement of a document.
A change proposal is created for an existing document.
A user with author rights creates a change proposal.
A new document version is created based on a change proposal.
An author implements an approved change proposal.
A validity extension request is created for a document.
A document's validity is extended after approval.
A releaser may approve validity extension.
A reviewer may approve validity extension.
An author may approve validity extension.
A new editing version of a document is created.
An author revises an existing document.
An attachment is marked for archiving.
An override request is created for a document.
A user with write access creates an override request.
A document is invalidated through override.
A releaser may approve override.
A reviewer may approve override.
An initiator may request override.
A document is archived and access is restricted.
A reactivation request is created for an invalidated document.
A business admin creates a reactivation request.
An archived document is reactivated.
Attachments are reactivated with the document.
A document is translated into another language.
A translator creates a translation of the document.
A translated language version is reviewed.
A reviewer checks the translation.
A translated language version is released.
A releaser approves the translation.
Authorization is assigned for a document.
A user is assigned authorization to a document.
A user group is assigned authorization to a document.
An external file is uploaded to a document.
A document is automatically converted to PDF format.
A document template is selected when creating a document.
An electronic signature is applied during document signing.
